plan.title: test(flaky): pre-pr-controller coverage_headroom mode-skip test fails intermittently and reddens master's gate

narratives.Description: Tests in `packages/core/src/pre-pr-controller/controller.test.ts` fail intermittently on master's post-merge CI ("coverage_headroom accepts exit 5 mode skip when policy re-read authorizes" at line 1501, and "refuses a second publish and a semantic digest mismatch" at line 408), which reddens master's tip merge gate and stalls the merge queue. Root cause: the controller stamps phase evidence at whole-second precision (`utcIso`) and `runObservablesComplete` refuses a required phase stamped before the previous one (`deny-out-of-order`); the test helpers observe every command phase (including `lint_iteration`) before they submit the `read` and `write` reviewer reports, so a second boundary that falls between the two steps stamps `lint_iteration` one second before `write`. This story makes the test file run on a frozen clock so no test depends on wall-clock timing; product code does not change.
narratives.UserStory: As a story worker merging through master's merge queue, I want the pre-PR controller tests to pass on every run, so that a flaky test does not turn master's tip gate red and stall every queued PR.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: One product PR (deft-story: 6484). 1. `packages/core/src/pre-pr-controller/controller.test.ts`: in a file-level `beforeEach`, fake only `Date` (`vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["Date"] })`) and freeze it with `vi.setSystemTime`; restore real timers in the file-level `afterEach`. Tests that pass an explicit `now` (for example the out-of-order test) keep their own timestamps. 2. Prove it: run the file 30+ times in a loop and under parallel load before and after, and run it once with a Date that advances on every read to show the old failure and the fix deterministically; put the counts and the root cause in the PR body. 3. One `changelog.d/` fragment. No retries, no timeout raise, no skip (#3156).
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

A unit test fails intermittently on master's post-merge CI, which turns master's tip merge gate red. `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` then refuses to enqueue every open PR until someone re-runs the job.

Test: `packages/core/src/pre-pr-controller/controller.test.ts` > "controller observations" > "coverage_headroom accepts exit 5 mode skip when policy re-read authorizes (#5791…)". The failure is `expected false to be true` at about line 1501.

## Evidence (2026-11-16/17)

- Master tip 7aef28cb5: the merge_group run passed; the post-merge push run 43975908795 failed this test; a re-run passed.
- Master tip b7b97394b: run at 00:28Z failed (reported by the #6422 worker as the same test); a re-run started at 01:43Z.
- Both commits passed the same suite in the merge queue minutes earlier, so the failure is timing- or environment-dependent, not caused by those commits.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given repeated runs of this test on a loaded CI runner, then it passes every time.
- The test does not depend on wall-clock timing or on state left by other tests in the same file.
narratives.Constraint:
- Retries, a raised timeout as the only fix, or skipping the test (#3156).
- Changing the product order check or timestamp precision in `controller.ts` / `types.ts`: the refusal is correct product behaviour; the test helpers create the race.
